verdict.rationale: The pack documents searchable transcripts, per-meeting summaries and action items, MCP Q&A through third-party AI assistants, and API access to notes with attendee lists. None of it shows Fellow itself surfacing past meetings with the same attendees or generating a pre-call brief of open threads. These are adjacent features and developer building blocks a user could assemble into prep, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I walk into each meeting prepped — the tool surfaces past meetings with the same people and a brief of open threads before the call
